answer: Hash-chained activity continuity makes each identity earn its place: every useful deed an agent performs is linked into a tamper-evident chain, each link committing to the last, so a newcomer starts at a dry horizon with nothing to show. Only a long, verified history builds an oasis of trust; a sybil farm would have to forge whole chains from scratch, and one zephyr of audit wind exposes gaps, breaks the chain, and burns the fake's stake.
